features.text: DecomposeUserTask: AI task decomposition: Convert user objectives to sequential action plans with formatted file export. (PUT /cells/ai/task/decompose)

AggregateCellsByColor: The Aggregate by Color API provides a convenient way to perform calculations on cells that share the same fill or font color. This API supports a range of aggregate operations, including count, sum, maximum value, minimum value, and average value, enabling you to analyze and summarize data based on color distinctions. (PUT /cells/calculate/aggregate/color)

CreateSpreadsheet: The Web API allows users to create a new spreadsheet with a specified name. Optionally, a template can be provided to initialize the spreadsheet with predefined content or formatting. (PUT /cells/spreadsheet/create)
GetWorksheetsWithLocalSpreadsheet: Fetches a complete list of worksheets from the currently active local spreadsheet. (PUT /cells/spreadsheet/worksheets)

AddWorksheetToSpreadsheet: The Web API enables users to add a new worksheet to a workbook, specifying the worksheet's type, position, and name. This function provides flexibility in managing workbook structure by allowing detailed control over worksheet addition. (PUT /cells/spreadsheet/add/worksheet)

DeleteWorksheetFromSpreadsheet: The Web API endpoint allows users to delete a specified worksheet from a workbook. This function provides a straightforward way to manage workbook structure by removing unnecessary or redundant worksheets. (PUT /cells/spreadsheet/delete/worksheet)

RenameWorksheetInSpreadsheet: The Web API endpoint allows users to rename a specified worksheet within a workbook. This function provides a straightforward way to update worksheet names, enhancing workbook organization and readability. (PUT /cells/spreadsheet/rename/worksheet)

CompressSpreadsheet: The Web API endpoint allows users to compress a spreadsheet to reduce its file size. This function provides a straightforward way to optimize the storage and performance of spreadsheets by applying a specified compression level. (PUT /cells/spreadsheet/compress)
RepairSpreadsheet: The Web API endpoint allows users to repair a spreadsheet. (PUT /cells/spreadsheet/repair)
GetMergedCellsInRemotedWorksheet: Get all merged cell area form a remote spreadsheet worksheet. (GET /cells/{name}/worksheets/{worksheet}/mergedcells)
GetMergedCellsInWorksheet: Get all merged cell areas from a local spreadsheet worksheet. (PUT /cells/spreadsheet/mergedcells)
AcceptAllRevisions: Accepts all tracked changes (revisions) in the local spreadsheet. (PUT /cells/spreadsheet/accept-all-revisions)
AcceptAllRevisionsInRemoteSpreadsheet: Accepts all tracked changes (revisions) in a remote spreadsheet. (PUT /cells/{name}/accept-all-revisions)
GetSpreadsheetStructure: Extracts the structural information of a local spreadsheet as a JSON object. (PUT /cells/spreadsheet/structure)
GetStructureInRemoteSpreadsheet: Extracts the structural information of a remote spreadsheet as a JSON object. (GET /cells/{name}/structure)
ProtectSpreadsheet: Applies dual-layer password protection to Excel spreadsheets, supporting both open and modify passwords with encryption. (PUT /cells/protection/spreadsheet)
UnprotectSpreadsheet: Removes dual-layer password protection from Excel spreadsheets, supporting both open and modify passwords with encryption. (PUT /cells/unprotection/spreadsheet)

SpreadsheetDigitalsignature: Adds digital signatures to Excel spreadsheets using X.509 certificates (.pfx files) for document authentication and integrity verification. (PUT /cells/digitalsignature/spreadsheet)
SmartMarkerTemplate: Generates reports using Smart Marker template technology with JSON data. (PUT /cells/report/smart/template)

It is particularly useful for cleaning up data entries and ensuring consistency in spreadsheet formatting (PUT /cells/{name}/worksheets/{worksheet

TrimCharacter: The TrimSpreadsheetContent API is designed to process and trim content within a remote spreadsheet. This API allows users to remove extra spaces, line breaks, or other unnecessary characters from the content of selected cells. It is particularly useful for cleaning up data entries and ensuring consistency in spreadsheet formatting (PUT /cells/content/trim)

UpdateWordCase: Specify changing the text case in a spreadsheet to switch between uppercase, lowercase, capitalizing the first letter of each word, or capitalizing the first letter of a sentence, and adjust the text according to specific needs. (PUT /cells/content/wordcase)

UpdateWordCaseInRemoteSpreadsheet: Specify changing the text case in a remote spreadsheet to switch between uppercase, lowercase, capitalizing the first letter of each word, or capitalizing the first letter of a sentence, and adjust the text according to specific needs. (PUT /cells/{name}/worksheets/{worksheet}/range/{range}/content/wordcase)

RemoveCharacters: Deletes user-defined characters, predefined symbol sets, or any substring from every cell in the chosen range while preserving formulas, formatting and data-validation. (PUT /cells/content/remove/characters)

RemoveCharactersInRemoteSpreadsheet: Deletes user-defined characters, predefined symbol sets, or any substring from every cell in the chosen range while preserving formulas, formatting and data-validation for a remote spreadsheet. (PUT /cells/{name}/worksheets/{worksheet}/range/{range}/content/remove/characters)

RemoveCharactersByPosition: Deletes characters from every cell in the target range by position (first/last N, before/after a substring, or between two delimiters) while preserving formulas, formatting and data-validation. (PUT /cells/content/remove/characters-by-position)

RemoveCharactersByPositionInRemoteSpreadsheet: Deletes characters from every cell in the target range by position (first/last N, before/after a substring, or between two delimiters) while preserving formulas, formatting and data-validation. (PUT /cells/{name}/worksheets/{worksheet}/range/{range}/content/remove/characters-by-position)

RemoveDuplicateSubstrings: Finds and removes repeated substrings inside every cell of the chosen range, using user-defined or preset delimiters, while preserving formulas, formatting and data-validation. (PUT /cells/content/remove/duplicate-substrings)

RemoveDuplicateSubstringsInRemoteSpreadsheet: Finds and removes repeated substrings inside every cell of the chosen range, using user-defined or preset delimiters, while preserving formulas, formatting and data-validation. (PUT /cells/{name}/worksheets/{worksheet}/range/{range}/content/remove/duplicate-substrings)

AddText: Specify appending text to multiple cells at once, allowing you to add prefixes, suffixes, labels, or any specific characters. You can choose the exact position of the text—in the beginning, at the end, or before or after certain characters in the cell. (PUT /cells/content/add/text)

AddTextInRemoteSpreadsheet: Specify appending text to multiple cells at once, allowing you to add prefixes, suffixes, labels, or any specific characters. You can choose the exact position of the text—in the beginning, at the end, or before or after certain characters in the cell. (PUT /cells/{name}/worksheets/{worksheet}/range/{range}/content/add/text)

ConvertText: Indicates converting the numbers stored as text into the correct number format, replacing unwanted characters and line breaks with the desired characters, and converting accented characters to their equivalent characters without accents. (PUT /cells/content/convert/text)

ConvertTextInRemoteSpreadsheet: Indicates converting the numbers stored as text into the correct number format, replacing unwanted characters and line breaks with the desired characters, and converting accented characters to their equivalent characters without accents. (PUT /cells/{name}/worksheets/{worksheet}/range/{range}/content/convert/text)

ExtractText: Indicates extracting substrings, text characters, and numbers from a spreadsheet cell into another cell without having to use complex FIND, MIN, LEFT, or RIGHT formulas. (PUT /cells/content/extract/text)
SplitText: Indicates performing text segmentation on the specified area according to the segmentation method, and outputting to the designated interval. (PUT /cells/content/split/text)
RemoveSpreadsheetBlankRows: Delete all blank rows that do not contain any data or other objects. (PUT /cells/remove/blank-rows)
RemoveSpreadsheetBlankColumns: Delete all blank columns that do not contain any data or other objects. (PUT /cells/remove/blank-columns)
RemoveSpreadsheetBlankWorksheets: Delete all blank rows that do not contain any data or other objects. (PUT /cells/remove/blank-worksheets)
RemoveDuplicates: Removes duplicate values in the worksheet/range/table. (PUT /cells/remove/duplicates)

FlipData: Transposes a specified data range (rows become columns, columns become rows). (PUT /cells/flip)
TransposeData: Transposes data in the specified range, switching rows and columns. (PUT /cells/transpose)
UnpivotRange: Unpivots data from the specified range, converting columns to rows. (PUT /cells/unpivot/range)
UnpivotTable: Unpivots data from the specified table, converting columns to rows. (PUT /cells/unpivot/table)
